errors.text_span: For each strategy, a dotted line of the same color represents the performance when using the typical representation (without corpus expansion)
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly implies that there is a corresponding dashed (not dotted) line for each of the six strategies. The plot only shows four dashed lines; there are no dashed lines for the "DPR w/o query" (black) or "DPR w/ gold" (yellow) strategies.
The black solid line for "DPR w/o query" is constant at a value of approximately 34.25, not 34.0.
The description fails to mention that the "DPR w/ gold" line starts at an x-axis value of 4 (Number of queries), unlike the other lines which mostly start at x=1.
The "DPR w/ top-1" (green line) strategy starts at an MRR@10 value of approximately 33.0 (at x=1), not 34.5.

errors.text_span: starts at 35.0 and decreases slightly to 34.5
errors.evidence: The "DPR w/ bottom-1" (purple line) strategy starts at approximately 34.8 (at x=1) and ends at approximately 34.7 (at x=10), not starting at 35.0 and ending at 34.5.
The "DPR w/ random" (blue line) strategy starts at an MRR@10 value of approximately 34.8 (at x=1), not 35.0.

The "DPR w/ curriculum" (red line) strategy shows a clear increasing trend from approximately 35.1 to a peak of 35.8. Describing this as "relatively flat" is an over-generalization that mischaracterizes the trend.
